_comment: Single source of truth for the app catalog. scripts/build_catalog.py regenerates README tables and per-category indexes from this file. status: built | wip | planned. Never hand-edit the generated tables.

categories.title: Developer Tools
categories.blurb: Semantic checks over code, CI, and repo history. Cheap enough to run on every commit.

apps.title: Semantic grep
apps.does: Find code by describing it: 'network call with no timeout'
apps.why: ast finds candidates, Jev judges; cheap enough for CI

apps.title: CI failure triage
apps.does: Real bug / flake / infra / dependency / config across CI history

apps.title: PR risk scorer
apps.does: Score a diff for blast radius and review depth needed
apps.why: routes review effort; score once, reweight free

apps.title: Flaky test finder
apps.does: Separate genuinely flaky tests from consistently failing ones
apps.why: per-test judgment, rates computed in Python

apps.title: Issue deduplicator
apps.does: Find the three issues that are the same bug
apps.why: pairwise Score whose levels are the actions

apps.title: Breaking change detector
apps.does: Flag diffs that break downstream consumers
apps.why: diff in code, materiality in Jev

apps.title: Changelog classifier
apps.does: Sort merged PRs into user-facing / internal / breaking
apps.why: selection not generation; code assembles the notes

apps.title: Log pattern miner
apps.does: Cluster millions of log lines into named failure modes

apps.title: Dependency auditor
apps.does: Judge whether a changelog entry affects your usage
apps.why: avoids upgrading blind on every release

apps.title: Test gap finder
apps.does: Which behaviours in this module have no test
apps.why: parser lists behaviours, Jev matches coverage

apps.title: Incident tagger
apps.does: Tag postmortems by cause class and contributing factors

categories.title: Documents & Contracts
categories.blurb: Ask documents questions, diff them, and check them against requirements. Nothing is ever paraphrased.

apps.title: Semantic Ctrl-F
apps.does: Ask a lease or ToS a plain-English question, get the exact clause
apps.why: whole document scored in one request; returns verbatim text

apps.title: Contract diff
apps.does: 'Our terms have changed' — what actually got worse for you
apps.why: difflib computes the diff, Jev judges materiality

apps.title: RFP compliance matrix
apps.does: Check a proposal covers all 60 requirements in a tender
apps.why: one Noul per requirement, conjunctive coverage

apps.title: Policy gap finder
apps.does: Which controls in a standard are unaddressed by your policy

apps.title: Invoice extractor
apps.does: Pull totals, dates, and line items from messy invoices
apps.why: regex finds candidates, Jev selects; verbatim guarantee

apps.title: Meeting action extractor
apps.does: Commitments, owners, and deadlines from a transcript
apps.why: selection over generation; no invented owners

apps.title: Spec ambiguity finder
apps.does: Sentences in a spec that two engineers would read differently
apps.why: the failure mode Jev itself has, turned into a tool

apps.title: Doc freshness auditor
apps.does: Which docs contradict the current codebase

apps.title: Clause library matcher
apps.does: Match incoming contract clauses to your approved library

apps.title: Redaction checker
apps.does: Find PII and confidential detail before a document goes out
apps.why: one Noul per hazard class, thresholded separately

apps.title: Translation QA
apps.does: Flag translations that changed meaning, not just wording
apps.why: two states compared, judgment on divergence

categories.title: Data Engineering
categories.blurb: Judgment applied per-row, per-pair, and per-field, at a price that makes whole-dataset passes ordinary.

apps.title: Entity resolver
apps.does: Dedupe two merged CRM or product catalogs
apps.why: Score levels ARE the actions; blocking in code

apps.title: Semantic data linter
apps.does: Find rows whose fields contradict each other

apps.title: Deep taxonomy classifier
apps.does: File items into a 3-level taxonomy

apps.title: ML feature extractor
apps.does: Turn text into features, train a model, measure the lift
apps.why: judgments as features; output is a trained model

apps.title: Schema mapper
apps.does: Map one system's columns onto another's
apps.why: pairwise field matching with a curator tier

apps.title: Survey response coder
apps.does: Code thousands of free-text answers against a codebook

apps.title: Address normalizer
apps.does: Reconcile inconsistent address formats to one record

apps.title: Product catalog normalizer
apps.does: Unify attributes across inconsistent supplier feeds
apps.why: extraction plus taxonomy in one pass

apps.title: Column type inferrer
apps.does: What IS this column, semantically, given its values
apps.why: code samples values, Jev names the concept

apps.title: Anomaly explainer
apps.does: Which detected outliers are real problems vs expected
apps.why: statistics in code, plausibility in Jev

apps.title: PII column scanner
apps.does: Which columns in a warehouse carry personal data

apps.title: Training label auditor
apps.does: Find mislabelled rows in an existing labelled dataset

categories.title: AI Infrastructure · Jev + LLM
categories.blurb: Jev sitting in front of, behind, and around a generative model. Guarding every call costs a rounding error.

apps.title: Agent tool router
apps.does: Pick from a 42-tool MCP catalog without stuffing schemas into context
apps.why: two-stage cascade: summaries wide, schemas narrow

apps.title: LLM guardrails
apps.does: Screen every input, output, and tool call for hazards
apps.why: cheap enough to guard EVERY call, which nobody does today

apps.title: Injection detector
apps.does: Catch instructions hidden in retrieved or user content

apps.title: RAG reranker
apps.does: Drop-in for a cross-encoder or Cohere Rerank

apps.title: RAG passage filter
apps.does: Drop passages that contradict, mislead, or carry injections

apps.title: Model router
apps.does: Send easy turns to a cheap model, hard ones to a frontier one
apps.why: calibrated difficulty plus an abstain path

apps.title: Citation verifier
apps.does: Check each claim against the source it cites

apps.title: Grounding checker
apps.does: Is this generated answer supported by the retrieved context

apps.title: Agent trace classifier
apps.does: Classify why agent runs failed, across thousands of traces

apps.title: Eval judge
apps.does: Score model outputs against a rubric, reproducibly
apps.why: calibrated and deterministic where an LLM judge drifts

apps.title: Agent memory filter
apps.does: Which stored memories are relevant to this turn
apps.why: rank the whole memory store in one request

apps.title: Context compressor
apps.does: Select which context to keep when the window is tight
apps.why: selection, so nothing is paraphrased away

apps.title: Tool output validator
apps.does: Did this tool actually return what was asked for
apps.why: catches silent tool failures agents ignore

categories.title: Finance
categories.blurb: Every number computed in Python. The model only ever supplies judgment.

apps.title: Statement categorizer
apps.does: Categorize years of bank and card transactions
apps.why: confidence gate: auto-file or ask me

apps.title: Subscription auditor
apps.does: Find every recurring charge, including the forgotten ones
apps.why: recurrence judged, totals computed in pandas

apps.title: Expense policy checker
apps.does: Which claims breach the written expense policy
apps.why: one Noul per policy rule, veto semantics

apps.title: Receipt triage
apps.does: Match receipts to card transactions and flag the gaps
apps.why: pairwise matching with a curator tier

apps.title: Invoice matcher
apps.does: Three-way match: PO, invoice, delivery note
apps.why: pairwise agreement judgment, arithmetic in code

apps.title: Vendor risk screener
apps.does: Screen suppliers against risk criteria from their documents

apps.title: Deduction classifier
apps.does: Which expenses are plausibly deductible, with a review queue
apps.why: confidence decides what a human sees

apps.title: Fraud signal extractor
apps.does: Turn transaction narratives into risk features
apps.why: features for a downstream fraud model

apps.title: Earnings call tagger
apps.does: Tag guidance, hedging, and tone shifts across transcripts

apps.title: Variance explainer
apps.does: Classify why each line missed budget, from the notes
apps.why: numbers in code, causes in Jev

categories.title: Business & Operations
categories.blurb: Routing, qualification, and risk detection over the text a business already generates.

apps.title: Lead qualifier
apps.does: Score inbound leads against your ICP, written as a paragraph
apps.why: score once, reweight as the ICP changes

apps.title: Support ticket triage
apps.does: Route by issue, product area, urgency, and churn risk

apps.title: Churn signal extractor
apps.does: Early warning from support and sales conversations

apps.title: Escalation detector
apps.does: Which threads need a manager before they blow up

apps.title: NPS comment coder
apps.does: Theme thousands of open-ended survey comments

apps.title: Sales call tagger
apps.does: Objections, competitors, and next steps from call notes

apps.title: Renewal risk scorer
apps.does: Which accounts are quietly drifting toward non-renewal

apps.title: Application screener
apps.does: Screen applications against explicit, job-related criteria
apps.why: criterion-by-criterion, auditable, with a human tier

apps.title: RFP response scorer
apps.does: Score supplier responses against weighted criteria

apps.title: Onboarding gap finder
apps.does: Which steps a new hire's docs never actually explain

apps.title: Competitor monitor
apps.does: Which competitor updates actually matter to your roadmap

categories.title: Personal Productivity
categories.blurb: Your own inbox, feeds, notes, and calendar — sorted by what you actually care about.

apps.title: Inbox triage
apps.does: What in my mail actually needs me today
apps.why: 5 independent judgments per message; sorts, never rewrites

apps.title: Feed ranker
apps.does: Rank Hacker News against your interests, in one sentence

apps.title: Calendar triage
apps.does: Which meetings you could skip or shorten

apps.title: Reading queue ranker
apps.does: Order a 400-item read-later pile by what you need now
apps.why: whole queue ranked in one request

apps.title: Note linker
apps.does: Find which existing notes a new note should link to

apps.title: Channel digest
apps.does: What happened in 12 channels that concerns you

apps.title: Task prioritizer
apps.does: Re-rank a task list against this week's actual goal

apps.title: Newsletter filter
apps.does: Keep the three items in a digest you'd have read

apps.title: Bookmark organizer
apps.does: File years of bookmarks into a taxonomy you describe

apps.title: Standup assembler
apps.does: Pull your actual week from commits, PRs and tickets

categories.title: Trust & Safety
categories.blurb: Company-specific, nuanced policy — not a generic toxicity score.

apps.title: Community moderator
apps.does: Apply YOUR written community rules, not a generic policy
apps.why: severity and confidence combine to allow/warn/review/block

apps.title: Marketplace listing checker
apps.does: Prohibited items, counterfeit signals, policy breaches
apps.why: one Noul per policy, thresholded separately

apps.title: Review authenticity
apps.does: Flag incentivised, templated, or fake-looking reviews

apps.title: Brand safety checker
apps.does: Is this placement context safe for this creative

apps.title: Scam pattern detector
apps.does: Advance-fee, impersonation, and phishing patterns in messages

apps.title: Age suitability rater
apps.does: Rate content against an age-band rubric you define

apps.title: Moderation appeal router
apps.does: Which appeals plausibly overturn the original decision

categories.title: Research & Science
categories.blurb: Screening, extraction, and verification over literature and field data.

apps.title: Paper screener
apps.does: Screen abstracts against a systematic review protocol
apps.why: conjunctive veto rules, not a weighted score

apps.title: Study data extractor
apps.does: Pull population, intervention, and outcomes from methods sections

apps.title: Interview coder
apps.does: Apply a thematic codebook to transcripts
apps.why: one Noul per theme; several can apply

apps.title: Methods gap finder
apps.does: Missing controls, sample sizes, or ethics statements

apps.title: Reproducibility auditor
apps.does: Does this paper give enough detail to reproduce it

apps.title: Dataset license checker
apps.does: Can we legally use this dataset the way we intend

apps.title: Grant fit scorer
apps.does: Which calls actually fit this proposal
apps.why: relevance ranking over a call catalog

apps.title: Reviewer matcher
apps.does: Match submissions to reviewers by expertise

categories.title: Realtime & Interactive
categories.blurb: ~150ms is under human perception, so judgment can sit inside a render loop or a keystroke.

apps.title: Semantic command palette
apps.does: Type what you want in English, get the right action
apps.why: runs per keystroke at typing speed

apps.title: Live chat moderation
apps.does: Moderate a live stream chat as it arrives

apps.title: Semantic form validator
apps.does: 'That doesn't look like a job title' — as they type

apps.title: Text adventure referee
apps.does: An NPC that judges whether your improvised action works
apps.why: programmable common sense in a game loop

apps.title: Live meeting copilot
apps.does: Flag commitments and dodged questions during the call

apps.title: Suggestion ranker
apps.does: Rank completions by what the user actually means
apps.why: whole candidate set ranked in one call

apps.title: Live alert router
apps.does: Page, ticket, or ignore — decided at alert time
